name: What should be planned before installing an accessible or aging-in-place shower bench?

mainEntity.name: What should be planned before installing an accessible or aging-in-place shower bench?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prepare for an accessible shower bench, plan the exact height, weight capacity, and surrounding clearances before framing and tile installation begin. Floating or fold-down seats require solid wood blocking installed inside the wall studs prior to closing the drywall to support significant weight safely. You will also want to plan for slip-resistant floor and seat finishes, strategically placed grab bars within easy reach, and a low-threshold or curbless shower entry to ensure smooth, safe movement into the space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Plan internal structural wall blocking for weight support, paired grab bar locations, slip-resistant materials, and an adjustable handheld shower wand within arm's reach.
